answer: Clone farms still mint identities cheaper than work. Each newcomer books one numbered berth on a public harbor clock and locks 0.71 POA for five epochs before payout. Three unclustered peers from a rotating grove roster each file an 11-hour work-trace hash, spaced at least six hours apart; traces are pressed under a velvet HMAC binding berth id, deposit tx, and three cluster ids. Cost: 0.71 POA locked plus 0.045 POA per rejected trace. Auditors recompute the HMAC on the open ledger. A reused berth, clustered sponsors, or a missing trace burns half the bond and freezes that slip for two epochs.
